authority: CEO R334 — separation enforcement test. CRM cannot alter technical state.

separation_tests.scenario: Buyer says 'P-16 is amazing, we want to license immediately.' CRM records interest_level=HIGH.
separation_tests.technology_fabric_action: NONE. P-16 remains T2-CONFIRMED. Buyer enthusiasm does NOT promote to T3.

separation_tests.scenario: Buyer says 'P-21 localization is insufficient, we reject.' CRM records commercial_outcome=REJECTED.
separation_tests.technology_fabric_action: NONE. P-21 remains T1. Buyer rejection does NOT demote to CEMETERY.
separation_tests.passed_if: P-21 state unchanged (T1, not CEMETERY) after CRM rejection

separation_tests.scenario: 5 buyers all say 'integration burden too high' for P-16. CKA-001 created.
separation_tests.technology_fabric_action: NONE. P-16 technical evidence unchanged. CKA is COMMERCIAL, not SCIENTIFIC.
separation_tests.passed_if: No scientific KA created. P-16 evidence ledger unchanged. CKA-001 stored in commercial layer only.

separation_tests.scenario: Buyer commissions P-02 experiment and returns PASS result. CRM records experiment_commissioned.
separation_tests.technology_fabric_action: Ingest buyer data through BUYER_ACTION_ID pipeline. If provenance verified + custody + attestation → PHYSICALLY_VALIDATED → T3. If not → BLOCKED.
separation_tests.passed_if: Technical state change ONLY through evidence pipeline, NOT through CRM status update

separation_tests.scenario: Deal reaches NEGOTIATION stage. Someone tries to mark P-16 as T5.
separation_tests.technology_fabric_action: BLOCKED. T5 requires T3 (physical validation) + T4 (relevant-environment). Deal stage does NOT grant T5.
separation_tests.passed_if: T5 NOT granted. P-16 remains T2-CONFIRMED.

enforcement_mechanism.technical_state_writes: ONLY through evidence ingestion pipeline (BUYER_ACTION_ID → provenance → classification → deterministic_state_transition)
enforcement_mechanism.crm_state_writes: ONLY through buyer interaction recording (human input, CEO-owned)
enforcement_mechanism.no_cross_writes: CRM layer has NO write access to technology_fabric state, evidence ledger, or knowledge atoms. Technology fabric has NO write access to CRM buyer records.
